name: Manako
title: Yesterday we pitched Manako on the Rising Stars stage at @Founders_Forum, with @joinstationf in Paris. Thank you to both for the room. AI changed work inside computers. It is moving into physical operations, and it can start with infrastructure that is already installed. Cameras already watch factories, stores, fuel stations and warehouses. Almost none of that becomes an action, because operations still depend on someone noticing, understanding and reporting what happened. Manako builds World Models for Business: AI that turns physical events into better business. Today we deploy Vision Agents. They use existing cameras to identify physical events and start the business action that follows. A spill on a forecourt becomes a cleaning job for the on-call contractor, with the clip attached, before a customer has to report it. Live now, including at Avia Thévenin & Ducrot’s unmanned fuel stations in France. Setting up a new site takes under five minutes. The ambition is the self-improving business. The physical record of every site, available to the systems that run it, so operations keep improving. People set the goals, the rules and the limits. What happens at your sites should not wait for someone to notice.
